title: Prove exact 25-term tariffs for orthogonal Boolean fanout triples
body:
Demand `(1,2,4)` over `F_2^3` is outside the zero-sum tariff theorem in #5304. This contribution resolves its Open next question 2: with three arbitrary dirty rows, one preserved source and arbitrary positive destination-row prices, the exact optimum has 25 indispensable linear terms, each with an attaining word. The proof extends to three nonzero pairwise orthogonal demands over any commutative unital Boolean ring.

The new one-insertion argument cuts at the sole source call. Both the suffix and inverse prefix must transport the same generator column to the demand, and each needs at least four ADDs. This gives the sharp bill `mu_i + 2 sum(c) + 2 min(c)`; the extra two ADDs may use any row, independently of the insertion row. In the multi-insertion classification, the former two-fixed-parent branch is impossible because the third demand lies outside the other two demands' ideal. New non-zero-sum words attain the remaining branches. Uniform prices simplify to `min(3mu, mu+8c)`, compared with the zero-sum predecessor's `min(3mu, mu+6c)`.

Only `research/orthogonal-boolean-fanout/` is added (five files): self-contained proof, standard-library verifier, exact source pins and registered replay metadata. This is an exact price envelope, not a claim to enumerate every unexposed Pareto vector. It does not change the selected frontier or establish a physical supplier/new kappa.

Validation on Python 3.12:

- Registered normal and optimized warning-strict replays pass with identical evidence: 456 demands, 11,400 constructed words, 91,200 formal forward/inverse column checks, 204,800 literal input checks, all 25 strict price exposures and ten controls.
- 81 independent weighted source-column Dijkstra queries confirm the new four-ADD bound. Five unrestricted full dirt-state shortest paths settle 90,347 states; exact optima are 3, 6, 6, 14 and 41/15. The U branches use column-search corroboration plus full endpoint replay; those five full-state queries do not cover U-optimal prices.
- Three disposable optimized-mode mutations reject underpricing the single-insertion branch, omitting a suffix gate and forcing the cheapest extra ADD destination to equal the insertion root.
- Package metadata/pins, committed-byte check, official export integrity and a read-only Git-free exported replay pass. Full-history ancestry checking was not run in the shallow checkout; every Git provenance pin is at the direct main parent. Hosted CI is pending.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/orthogonal-boolean-fanout
```
